title: ChatCX
tagline: 🚀 ChatCX is an AI-powered agent designed to provide real-time insights and intelligence from Web3 Twitter.
description: It tracks, analyzes, and delivers actionable data on emerging trends, narratives, and market-shifting conversations in the crypto space. The agent is built to help users stay ahead of the curve by providing pure, actionable insights powered by advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Reinforcement Learning algorithms.
how_its_made:
The project uses:
- Autonome for infrastructure: Agent is live, hosted and usable by anybody else.
- Hyperbolic for LLM APIs to provide the best uninterrupted insights.
- Privy's server wallet for Crypto Parrot - a sub-product to ChatCX. 

And all other classic tools and frameworks.
